senses.gloss: m. (קִרְצֵף) scratching, currying with a strigil.
units: Tosef. Bets. II, 17 איזהו ק׳ גדולים וכ׳ ed. Zuck. (Var. קִרְסוּף) what kind of currying is called ḳirtsuf? That which is done with large-toothed combs, which do not wound, opp. קֵירוּד; Y. ib. II, end, 61ᵈ; Bab.
<cite ref="Beitzah 23a:14">Ib.</cite> <he>בין ק׳ בין קרוד שרי</he> currying is permitted (on the Holy Day) whether with large or with small strigils; v. <cite ref="S01159"><he>קירוּד</he></cite>.
